# Browser profile metadata capture

Captured through the running product's read-only Group show operation on
2026-11-12. This fixture retains only Group version/times/state, two registered
actors' runtime/runner/enabled/registration metadata and one Web Model target's
state, kind, URL, saved time, next-delivery mode and completed delivery status.

Group and actor names are aliases. The Group title is blank; registration UUIDs
and the conversation ID use fixed redaction placeholders. All other retained
values are unchanged. Environment, commands, credentials, conversation bodies,
user-entered text, inventories and unrelated state are omitted.

Tests make explicitly labeled configuration/admission mutations over these
captured records inside temporary homes. Those controls do not claim a captured
second account, provider transcript or two-profile runtime proof.
